items.description: A special NIA court ruled that four men were not guilty of aiding terrorists in the 2020 attack. The prosecution could not establish any direct link between the men and the terrorists involved in the incident. Although two Army soldiers were killed, the evidence presented was circumstantial and insufficient. The court emphasized the necessity of legal proof despite the crime's severity and implications.
